blocks.text: My honest, lived-in answer to where to have the best breakfast in Bondi right now: [bills](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/bills-bondi-beach) on Hall Street for the ricotta hotcakes everyone talks about, [Porch and Parlour](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/porch-and-parlour) up the north end for a table near the sand, and [Lox Stock & Barrel](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/lox-stock-and-barrel) when I'm craving a proper bagel. Those three cover most moods — but Bondi's breakfast runs deep, so let me walk you through how I actually eat my way through a morning here.

I've lived and eaten around this beach for years, and breakfast is genuinely the meal Bondi does best. Cafés open early, the coffee is taken very seriously, and half the joy is the walk between them with salt still in your hair. If you want the wider field, we keep a full guide to [Bondi's best breakfast and brunch](/bondi-eat-and-drink/breakfast-brunch-bondi-beach) and a separate one for [the best cafés and coffee](/bondi-eat-and-drink/best-cafes-bondi-beach) — but here's where I actually go.
My go-to breakfast spots
bills, Hall Street

bills is the one visitors ask me about by name, and for once the hype holds up. Bill Granger's ricotta hotcakes with banana and honeycomb butter are a genuine Sydney institution, and the sweetcorn fritters and creamy scrambled eggs are just as good. It's bright, buzzy and unmistakably Bondi. It's popular, so expect a wait on weekends — check the bills site for current hours before you head down.
Porch and Parlour, North Bondi

If I'm choosing on vibe alone, Porch and Parlour wins. It sits up at the quieter north end near the surf club, all greenery and easy light, and the menu leans fresh and vegetable-forward — think generous breakfast bowls, plant-leaning plates and very good coffee. It's my pick for a slow, unhurried morning after a swim.
Lox Stock & Barrel, Glenayr Avenue

For something heartier, Lox Stock & Barrel does European deli-style breakfasts and bagels with the fish and meat cured in-house. The lox bagel is the obvious order, but the shakshuka-style plates and the egg dishes are what keep me coming back on a cold morning.
Gertrude & Alice, Hall Street

And when I want breakfast to turn into a two-hour affair, it's [Gertrude & Alice](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/gertrude-and-alice-cafe-bookstore) — a much-loved second-hand bookshop and café where you eat surrounded by towering shelves. Grab a coffee, a plate and a book you didn't plan to buy. It's the least beachy spot on this list and all the more charming for it.

The Bondi breakfast secret isn't a café — it's timing. On weekends the queues at the famous spots start building around 9am. If you rock up by 7.30 or 8, you'll walk straight in, get the best light for photos and have the promenade almost to yourself. Sleep in and you're queuing.

blocks.title: Menus and hours change
blocks.text: Bondi cafés tweak menus, prices and opening times constantly. I've kept this guide to places I trust rather than quoting numbers that go stale, so check each venue's own site or socials for current menus and hours before you set out.
A few more, depending on the morning
The four above are my defaults, but I send people all over the beach depending on what they're after. Here's the shortlist I reach for when the mood's a bit different.
For a table near the water

Up the north end, [Speedos Cafe](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/speedos-cafe) is the local institution for eggs and a swim, and [North Bondi Fish](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/north-bondi-fish) does a more polished sit-down morning right by the sand. My sentimental favourite is [The Crabbe Hole](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/the-crabbe-hole), the tiny coffee window tucked beneath the Icebergs pool at the south end — barely any seats, but the view is the whole point. For the full run of tables with water in front of them, that's our [beachfront and ocean-view guide](/bondi-eat-and-drink/waterfront-dining-bondi-beach).
For the coffee first, food second

When the coffee is the actual mission, I point people at [% Arabica](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/arabica-bondi) on the promenade and [Will & Co](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/will-and-co-hq-tasting-bar) for a properly dialled-in cup. Both do a pastry or a light bite, but you're going for what's in the cup.
For something lighter or plant-based

For açai bowls, smoothies and the green-juice end of things, [Cali Press](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/cali-press) is the reliable one, and Porch and Parlour (above) covers vegetable-forward brunch just as well. If that's your morning, our [vegan and vegetarian guide](/bondi-eat-and-drink/vegan-vegetarian-bondi-beach) has the rest.
For a bakery breakfast on the move

Some mornings breakfast is just a good pastry and a coffee eaten on a bench facing the water. [Sonoma](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/sonoma-bakery-cafe-bondi) is my go-to for sourdough and baked goods, and there's a whole city of them in our [bakeries and sweets guide](/bondi-eat-and-drink/bakeries-sweets-bondi-beach).
How to plan a proper Bondi breakfast morning
My favourite way to do it is to make breakfast the centrepiece of the whole morning rather than a quick refuel. Here's the loop I'd send a friend on.

stops.title: Sunrise swim or walk
stops.detail: Start at the beach before the crowds — a dawn dip or a stroll along the promenade earns your breakfast.

stops.title: Coffee and a table
stops.detail: Beat the weekend queue at bills or Porch and Parlour while it's still calm.

stops.title: The Bondi to Bronte walk
stops.detail: Work it off on the coastal path — one of the great free things to do in Sydney.

stops.title: Second coffee
stops.detail: Because this is Bondi, and one is never really enough.

items.q: What is the most famous breakfast in Bondi?
items.a: bills on Hall Street, for the ricotta hotcakes with banana and honeycomb butter — a Sydney classic that draws visitors from all over. The sweetcorn fritters and scrambled eggs are just as loved.

items.q: Where's the best breakfast with a beach view in Bondi?
items.a: Porch and Parlour at the north end sits close to the sand and surf club with lovely light. For a table right by the water, Speedos Cafe and North Bondi Fish are up the north end, and The Crabbe Hole is the tiny coffee window under the Icebergs pool at the south end. Our beachfront and ocean-view guide rounds up the rest.

items.q: Do I need to book breakfast in Bondi?
items.a: Most breakfast cafés run on walk-ins rather than bookings, so the real trick is timing. Arrive before 8am on weekends and you'll skip the queues at the popular spots; turn up mid-morning on a weekend and you may be in for a wait.

items.q: Where can I get a good bagel in Bondi?
items.a: Lox Stock & Barrel on Glenayr Avenue is the go-to — a European-style deli baking bread daily and curing its own fish and meat. The lox bagel is the signature order.

Bondi café prices sit at the higher end of Sydney, as you'd expect for a beachside suburb, but you'll find everything from a quick takeaway coffee and pastry to a full sit-down feast. Check each venue's current menu for prices before you go.

blocks.text: That's the honest local rundown. Bondi doesn't really do a bad breakfast — but do it early, take your time, and let the walk between coffees be part of the experience. See you out there.

blocks.title: Looking for more than breakfast?
blocks.text: This is my personal shortlist, not the whole map. Our [Bondi eat and drink directory](/bondi-eat-and-drink) has every café, restaurant and bar in the neighbourhood — 160+ venues you can filter by cuisine, area, price or who you're with, whether you're after brunch now or dinner later.
